basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

content_sections.heading: IIT Kharagpur Senior Research Fellow (SRF) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the interview date or the selection method.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur, Sponsored Research and Industrial Consultancy
Twin-Combustor Hybrid Rocket Motor with Energetic Fuel Compositions (Project Code – R/TCC)
Directorate of Futuristic Technology Management (DFTM), Defence Research and Development Organisation, Ministry of Defence
24 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier
Consolidated compensation per month, depending on qualification and experience (printed as "upto 0")

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course, selected through a process described in any one of the following: Scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests – CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. The selection process through national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc. Two years of research experience is required along with the above. B.Tech./B.E. in Aerospace/Mechanical Engg. with GATE score OR M.Tech./M.E. in Aerospace/Mechanical Engg. with Specialization in Propulsion/Thermal field. Two years of research experience. Experience in the design, development, and experimental testing of hybrid rocket motors; static firing and performance evaluation of rocket motors. Experience in handling and processing of solid fuels and energetic materials; and instrumentation, data acquisition, and analysis of propulsion experiments. The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation per month depends on qualification and experience; the notice prints it as "upto 0". The tenure is 24 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kharagpur Senior Research Fellow (SRF)
content_sections.text: The notice states that applications are invited online and must be submitted by 3 December 2026. It does not print the web address of the application form. The application fee is Rs. 0 for every category, yet the notice states that the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form. It prints this account for fee deposit through RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking etc.: Bank name: State Bank of India (00202) Bank address: P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore; West Bengal-721302 Name of bank A/C: IIT SRIC-OM Account Account No.: 39502115210 IFSC code: SBIN0000202 SWIFT code: SBININBB339

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice refers to an interview and says that only candidates called for it will be considered; meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called. The notice does not give the interview date or mode.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Research Fellow vacancies are there at IIT Kharagpur?
faq.answer: There is 1 Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post in the Department of Aerospace Engineering, for the project "Twin-Combustor Hybrid Rocket Motor with Energetic Fuel Compositions".

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Kharagpur SRF post?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course, selected through CSIR-UGC NET (including lectureship) or GATE, or through specified national level examinations, with two years of research experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 32 years, as on the last date of advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules if any.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are invited online. The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary assignment in a time bound research project, with a tenure of 24 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. Who is funding the project?
faq.answer: The project is sponsored by the Directorate of Futuristic Technology Management (DFTM), Defence Research and Development Organisation, Ministry of Defence.

faq.question: Q9. Does meeting the qualification guarantee an interview call?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.
